title: [intraday] aggregateIntradayBars: characterization test for interval guards, an empty list and a halted bar
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for aggregateIntradayBars in src/intraday.ts: interval guards and halted bars
- aggregateIntradayBars([], 25) throws INVALID_AGGREGATION_INTERVAL
- aggregateIntradayBars([], 5) throws INVALID_AGGREGATION_INTERVAL
- aggregateIntradayBars([], 20) is []
- aggregateIntradayBars([{ securityId: "sec_a", sessionDate: "2026-10-13", intervalIndex: 3, state: "HALTED", observedAt: "t", ingestedAt: "t", dataQuality: "GOOD", corporateActionIds: [], flags: [], schemaVersion: "foundation-d.1-10m-v1", revision: 1, provenance: { provider: "p", dataset: "d", retrievalId: "r", ingestionVersion: "i", normalizerVersion: "n" } }], 30) is [{ securityId: "sec_a", sessionDate: "2026-10-13", intervalIndex: 1, sourceIntervalMinutes: 10, targetIntervalMinutes: 30, state: "HALTED" }]

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v5): Peace's task (source: peace). aggregateIntradayBars is tested with 60-minute aggregation of full sessions; the INVALID_AGGREGATION_INTERVAL guard (25, 5), an empty list, and a single halted bar (HALTED group, bucket index) are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1fbe917, live 28-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v5); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with aggregateIntradayBars stubbed); suite 614/614 with all sixteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
